segments.segment_summary: Two men are outdoors on a grassy area, preparing parts for a John Deere seeder. One man changes out the meters from corn to soybean and then pours soybean seeds into the seeder hopper from a bucket.

key_moments.caption: A man places a seeder meter part into a yellow hopper.
A first-person view of soybean seeds being poured from a bucket into a yellow seeder hopper.
A first-person view of a man reassembling the seeder meter.
A first-person view of the man placing the reassembled meter back into the hopper.

segments.segment_summary: A man in a tractor cab explains that they are getting ready to plant soybeans. He shows the seed tender hooked up to a pickup truck, which then drives away. Brief shots show a vertical tillage tool and the seed tender parked by a field.

key_moments.caption: A man in a tractor cab talks to the camera, with the farmyard visible behind him.
The view from inside the tractor cab shows a pickup truck with a seed tender trailer in the farmyard.
The pickup truck and seed tender drive down a dirt road away from the farm.
A large, folded vertical tillage tool is shown parked on the edge of a field.
The seed tender is parked on a grassy edge next to a large tilled field.

segments.segment_summary: A montage of aerial and ground-level shots shows a green John Deere tractor pulling a seeder through a large, tilled field, planting soybeans.

key_moments.caption: An aerial view shows a tractor and seeder planting in a field.
A side view shows the seeder's wheels digging into the soil and planting seeds.
A rear aerial view follows the tractor and seeder as it makes a pass across the field.
A close-up side view follows the tractor and seeder as it moves along the edge of the field.

segments.segment_summary: A man in the back of a blue pickup truck lifts a heavy bag of Dairyland Seed Corn while his golden retriever dog lies next to him. He then carries the bag away on his shoulder.

key_moments.caption: A man leans into the back of a pickup truck where a golden retriever is lying down.
The man lifts a heavy bag of seed corn onto his shoulder.
The man walks away from the truck carrying the seed bag.
